messages:
maya_support: Escalating Pathway Health (org: 'pathway-trial') - onboarding failing: customers see 502s and duplicate token counts during bulk import. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7890
lee_cs: Is activation blocked for the cohort or intermittent? Any immediate customer asks?
maya_support: Blocked for the bulk job. They paused retries but observed a big spike in token usage; concerned about billing. SDK v2.6.0. Region: us-east-1.
rachel_csm: I can handle customer-facing note. Proposed comms: 1) immediate acknowledgement + apology 2) temporary billing hold while we investigate 3) workaround: split job into 4 smaller chunks OR use our resumable uploader 4) 3pm ET bridge with eng + hourly updates 5) if >8h, propose onboarding credit and assign onboarding specialist.
adrian_eng: Root cause looks like concurrent-kv-upserts causing transient 502s under large parallelism. Hotfix: throttle per-tenant upsert concurrency and enforce server-side dedupe. Canary ETA ~50m, full rollout ~2h if metrics stable. Temporary mitigation: we can enforce a per-tenant concurrency cap of 6 for Pathway.
incidents_bot: Canary rollout initiated: job 200345 for kv-upsert-service (canary). Dashboard: https://ci.redwood.com/200345
lee_cs: Draft customer message ready. Including ops snippet for their infra team - @adrian_eng please confirm:
```
# recommended: split import into smaller batches
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","concurrency":6,"chunks":4}'
```
adrian_eng: Confirmed. Also they can add header `X-Prefer-ServerDedupe: true` to reduce duplicate token writes.
maya_support: Updated ticket with workaround and monitoring checks (kv.502.rate, tenant.token-spike). Paused client auto-retries for their org.
lee_cs: Sending ack and scheduling 3pm ET bridge. Flagging renewal_risk=ELEVATED if >24h. Will post hourly updates in this thread and loop Finance for billing hold. :white_check_mark:
